exercise.name: Weighted Sissy Squat
steps: Hug a plate to your chest and hold a post with your free hand.
Rise onto the balls of your feet and lean back slightly.
Push your knees forward to lower, keeping knees, hips and shoulders in line.
Push back up using your thighs.
exercise.one_line_summary: As the sissy squat: on the balls of the feet, knees pushed forward, knees-hips-shoulders in one line leaning back; a plate hugged to the chest and the free hand on a post. End knees ~103 deg. Quads are the target.

setup.target: A plate hugged flat on the chest with the left forearm; right hand on an upright post.
setup.tolerance: plate on the chest, fist on the post

setup.target: On the balls of the feet, heels up.

movement.path: Knees travel forward; thighs and trunk stay one line (library step 3).

muscles.emg: Quadriceps highest near 90 deg knee bend (S2); knees forward with an upright trunk loads the knee extensors (S1).
muscles.role: Only mover: lowers and lifts the body.
muscles.surface: Front of the thigh, hip to knee.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Buttocks drop back, trunk tips forward.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Breaks the one-line lean; becomes a squat.

sources.citation: Straub RK, Powers CM. 2024. A biomechanical review of the squat exercise: implications for clinical practice. Int J Sports Phys Ther 19(4):490-501. doi:10.26603/001c.94600
sources.what_it_gave: Knees travelling forward over the toes and an upright trunk shift the load to the knee extensors (quadriceps).

sources.citation: Marchetti PH, Jarbas da Silva J, Schoenfeld BJ, et al. 2016. Muscle activation differs between three different knee joint-angle positions during a maximal isometric back squat exercise. J Sports Med 2016:3846123. doi:10.1155/2016/3846123
sources.what_it_gave: Quadriceps activity highest at a 90 deg knee angle; hamstrings similar across angles.
